items.note: yof does not read Dockerfiles or container images.

extra.note: Public by design: the About Us page lists customer feedback to anyone. server.ts at the pinned commit guards only /api/Feedbacks/:id, not the list.
Public by design: whoami answers every visitor and returns an empty user when no one is signed in (server.ts line 628 has no sign-in check).
server.ts sets only nosniff and frameguard; there is no Content-Security-Policy, and the official list has no challenge for missing headers.
The same inline TLS private key in the second copy of the Terraform file.
The RSA private key that signs the shop's sign-in tokens is written in the source. The list's JWT challenges use other weaknesses (the 'none' algorithm and key confusion).
A TLS private key written inline in the Terraform file. 'Misplaced IaC Files' is about reaching these files over the web, not about the key inside them.

items.note: yof's sign-in checks need a sign-in route that answers 2xx with a token or a cookie. NodeGoat answers its sign-in with a redirect, so the benchmark signs in itself and those two checks cannot run.

items.name: A4 Insecure DOR
items.note: yof's tenant test creates its own record through a JSON API and reads it back as account B. NodeGoat's pages are server-rendered forms with no such API, so the test cannot be set up.

items.name: A5 Misconfig
items.note: The fix the app documents for this topic (server.js, "Fix for A5") adds the security headers that yof's surface group checks for.
